summary: Customer handles a petroleum stream, currently uses laboratory water determination, and wants to investigate a fiber-based measurement closer to the process for earlier detection of changes. The analyzer would be outside the process area. They ask what to clarify and what a first comparison experiment should establish before selecting equipment.
